limitations: One matrix on a warm, initially empty pool; no sustained throughput or maximum-capacity claim.
Six concurrency-100 creates were rejected with HTTP 429 / CapacityRejected; none is counted as a successful creation or a deletion failure.
Five-second pauses separate batches, but Delete is submitted immediately for each ready sandbox.
Runtime cleanup timings are host-log observations, not per-stage VM-exit or replacement-slot-ready measurements.
Twenty-three namespace path names predated the workload and were preserved; the network check detects new untracked names relative to that baseline.

Real node loss and storage/transport fault injection were not exercised in ACK; temporary registry unavailability, unknown inspection results and failed Delete retry are covered by Go regression tests.
